valchitecture_cfg_verbosity: How much this mod writes to the log.
valchitecture_cfg_skill_gain: How fast the Building skill levels; 2 is twice as fast.
valchitecture_cfg_longer_reach: Increased build reach with skill increase.
valchitecture_cfg_stronger_pieces: Increased piece health and support with skill increase.
valchitecture_cfg_cheaper_swings: Decreased stamina usage with skill increase.
valchitecture_cfg_repair_upgrades: Repairing a piece raises its health and support to your current skill.
valchitecture_cfg_station_range: Multiplier on crafting station build range.
valchitecture_cfg_extension_range: Multiplier on allowed extension distance from the station.
valchitecture_cfg_everything_supports: Allows all pieces to support pieces above it.
valchitecture_cfg_furniture_supports: Allows base game furniture to support pieces above it.
valchitecture_cfg_ignore_clipping: Allows pieces to be built inside of others.
valchitecture_cfg_ignore_no_build_zones: Allows building inside locations that forbid it.
valchitecture_cfg_ignore_biome_limits: Allows biome-specific pieces to be built in any biome.
valchitecture_cfg_guard_used: Blocks removing pieces another player is using. Off is vanilla.
valchitecture_cfg_camera_toggle: Turn the build camera on or off while in a mode.
valchitecture_cfg_copy_button: Held with a copy modifier to copy the targeted piece.
valchitecture_cfg_copy_modifier_no_rotat: Copy the targeted piece, keeping your current rotation.
valchitecture_cfg_copy_modifier_with_rot: Copy the targeted piece and its rotation.
valchitecture_cfg_edit_cancel: Put a held piece back where it came from.
valchitecture_cfg_nudge_toggle: Freeze the piece so the nudge keys move it.
valchitecture_cfg_nudge_vertical_modifie: Hold with Forward/Back to nudge up and down.
valchitecture_cfg_rotation_copy: Take the rotation of the targeted piece.
valchitecture_cfg_rotation_spin_modifier: Hold while scrolling to spin the piece in the plane you face.
valchitecture_cfg_rotation_tilt_modifier: Hold while scrolling to tilt the piece toward or away.
valchitecture_cfg_snap_mode_cycle: Cycle Auto, Manual, Grid and Off.
valchitecture_cfg_snap_target_modifier: Hold to cycle snap points on the targeted piece.
valchitecture_cfg_snap_point_reset: In Manual, set both snap points back to automatic.
valchitecture_cfg_step_rate_large_modifi: Hold to change the step rate in larger jumps.
valchitecture_cfg_camera_move_speed: Camera speed, in meters per second.
valchitecture_cfg_camera_terrain_collisi: Stop the camera passing through the ground.
valchitecture_cfg_rotation_world_axes: Rotate around world axes instead of the piece's own.
valchitecture_cfg_rotation_step: Degrees per scroll notch at step rate 1.
valchitecture_cfg_gizmo_fits_piece: Scale the rings to enclose the piece.
valchitecture_cfg_gizmo_color_x: Color of the pitch ring, as hex.
valchitecture_cfg_gizmo_color_y: Color of the yaw ring, as hex.
valchitecture_cfg_gizmo_color_z: Color of the roll ring, as hex.
valchitecture_cfg_nudge_step: Meters per nudge at step rate 1.
valchitecture_cfg_grid_size: Grid spacing in meters for Grid snap mode.
valchitecture_cfg_hammers_call: Build mode: gizmo, nudging, snapping and wider reach.
valchitecture_cfg_gathered_hoard: Building takes missing materials from chests within reach.
valchitecture_cfg_huginns_counsel: Edit mode: pick up built pieces and place them again.
valchitecture_cfg_eirs_touch: One repair swing repairs every damaged piece nearby.
valchitecture_cfg_ravens_view: A build camera that leaves your character to work around the workbench.
valchitecture_cfg_longhouse_stores: Chests in a workbench's range supply building.
valchitecture_cfg_bifrost_step: The build camera can move from one workbench to the next.
valchitecture_cfg_ravens_reach: Pieces are placed where the build camera is.
valchitecture_cfg_roots_of_the_hall: Workbenches linked by overlapping ranges share their chests.
valchitecture_cfg_dvergr_thrift: Materials of removed pieces go to chests or your inventory.
valchitecture_cfg_extra_snap_points: Enables adding extra snap points to build pieces.
valchitecture_cfg_extra_snap_points_pole: Extra Snap Points: Poles And Beams
Ends and points along each side of poles, beams and other pieces with two snap points.
valchitecture_cfg_extra_snap_points_tria: Edges and centers on triangular pieces.
valchitecture_cfg_extra_snap_points_2d_r: Edges and centers on floors, walls and other flat pieces.
valchitecture_cfg_extra_snap_points_box: Face centers and edge midpoints on block pieces.
valchitecture_cfg_extra_snap_points_hand: Fixed layouts for fences, stakes, furniture and other pieces the shapes do not suit.
valchitecture_cfg_extra_snap_points_terr: A snap point on leveling and smoothing tools, so they can snap to a floor edge.
valchitecture_cfg_extra_snap_points_grid: Spacing of points across large flat pieces, in meters. Minimum 0.5; 0 turns the grid off.
valchitecture_cfg_enable_per_piece: Enables toggles for snapping and support per piece.
valchitecture_cfg_snap_points: Adds extra snap points and names this piece's points. Off leaves it as shipped.
valchitecture_cfg_supports: Allows this piece to support pieces above it.
